newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 17.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivorian government to privatise management of small agricultural operations, including plantations, fishing and stock rearing, across the country as part of efforts to liberalise the farm sector.
- Chinese Foreign Minister Qian Qichen says during brief stopover in Abidjan that his government would like President Henri Konan Bedie to pay an official visit to China.

- Libya's foreign minister, Omar Mustafa al-Montasser, visits Ivory Coast; seeks ways of reviving bilateral cooperation and discusses forthcoming Organisation of African Unity foreign ministers meeting to be held in Tripoli in February.
- Ivory Coast's Higher Islamic Council (CSI) launches preparations for a world Islamic Congress it plans to host from May 16 to 19

- Government and Ivorian Popular Front opposition party have had contacts after President Bedie's announcement that he would like a broader based government but no substantive talks; party sources say government has made no formal proposal offering it a place in government.
- Employees at UNICAO cocoa processing factory angry over pay and bonuses
- Banned Ivorian student federation FESCI calls for 72-hour university strike from January 22
